اغتفرنا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرْنَا (iḡtafarnā) /iɣ.ta.far.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرْنَا (uḡtufirnā) /uɣ.tu.fir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
